source: Arbitrum One archive RPC, everything at block_number: the price provider's getQuote() answer from a debug_traceCall (callTracer) of the pool's getSellAndBuyPrices(), and under it the answer of the quote extension the provider calls; feeds[n] from the oracle's getter 0xb5e4b813(feed id) for n = 0 (USDC), 1 (ETH), 2 (BTC); oracle_word is the oracle's storage slot 0x8dfdc825dd0453e7c80b1c1d32ae910e35d6efe9000000000000000000000000; slot0 is the pool's slot 0 as the extension read it in the trace; extension_state_word and the two words under quote_extension are storage of the extension 0xf1463419c4ac04aa1ac7fcc7b7930e1f61844c16 (the latter at the last block); the block timestamp from the header.
